title: Pinetucket Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Renovated to studs, a 2-Bedroom + Bunk Loft Seaside home steps from Seaside Avenue, the pools, family park, and only a 5-minute walk to the beach! Two king bedrooms, bunk room, chef's kitchen, with designer furnishings and touches throughout.
description_expanded: Description486 FOREST STREET2 Kings, 1 Bunk Bed (twin over double) - Sleeps 7Prime Forest Street Location in the Heart of SeasideThis stunning Seaside vacation retreat is beautifully renovated and perfectly positioned on Forest Street, offering comfort, space, and flexibility for an exceptional coastal getaway. With private parking for two and an unbeatable location just steps from the tennis courts, swimming pools, fitness center, and playground, guests are only a five-minute walk from the beach and an easy stroll to Seaside’s Town Center filled with shops, dining, and entertainment.Welcoming Outdoor Spaces & Thoughtful DesignGuests are welcomed through a charming central foyer framed by two open-air porches adorned with classic Seaside flower boxes. These inviting outdoor spaces set the tone for relaxed coastal living and connect seamlessly to the home’s thoughtfully designed interior. One side of the home opens to the chef’s kitchen and dining area, while the other reveals a spacious living room with vaulted ceilings and a decorative fireplace, creating a warm and airy gathering space.Chef’s Kitchen & Comfortable Living AreasThe chef’s kitchen is fully equipped for entertaining, featuring a four-burner Wolf range, Sub-Zero refrigerator and freezer, and a wet bar with a Sub-Zero wine cooler. A dining table comfortably seats six, with additional seating for three at the expansive kitchen island. Just outside, the oversized porch bed swing provides a favorite spot to unwind in the evening breeze. The adjacent living room offers vaulted ceilings, a fireplace (for display only), and ample seating for relaxed nights in.Spacious Bedrooms & Flexible Sleeping ArrangementsThe first floor features two king bedrooms designed for comfort and privacy. The rear primary king suite offers a flat-screen smart TV, fireplace, custom built-in storage, shared patio access, and a spa-inspired ensuite bath with dual vanities and a glass-enclosed walk-in shower. The second king bedroom includes a smart TV, charming window bench, and generous built-ins, with access to a renovated hallway bath featuring a deep soaking tub, walk-in shower, and single vanity.A spiral staircase leads to a playful loft bunk room—perfect for kids or teens—featuring a twin-over-full bunk, dresser, hanging storage, wall-mounted TV, its own A/C unit, and double doors that open to a breezy porch retreat.A Perfect Seaside EscapeBlending classic Seaside charm with modern upgrades, this Forest Street home offers exceptional indoor and outdoor living in one of Seaside, Florida’s most desirable locations. With its walkable access to the beach, town center, and top amenities, this inviting retreat provides the perfect backdrop for an unforgettable Seaside vacation. Need more space, the guest cottage, London's Bungalow, can accommodate 2 more guests. Renting the two together? Use this link - Pinetucket Combo.Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break | 5-night minimum Summer | 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum WinterFeaturesFeatures 352 yards (approximately a 5-minute walk) to beach access at East Ruskin PavilionPrivate Seaside Residential Beach: The Largest private residential beach on Scenic Highway 30AFlat-screen TVs in every bedroomWasher & Dryer Full-size laundry roomPeacock Alley Linens: Fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley sheets and towels throughout the homeAccess to Amenities: 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts & 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized Service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking: 2 parking passes included. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibitedNo Pets Allowed
